title: Book forest
author: Rituparna Khan
text:
Weaved.
She weaved
with a bit of salt.
She weaved
with a bit of sugar.
She weaved
with a bit of spices.
She weaved
with a bit of sour.
She weaved
with a bit of bitter.
Weaved and weaved and weaved.
Till it grew up to a huge biodiversity.
A biodiversity of
tangy river swerving her fawning course...
teaching us to pursue our goals.
Sweetened foliage canopying mystic skyline...
training us to be calm whatever be may.
Saline earth to beget life...
showing us to believe in the positive.
Bitter air with blended elements...
Putting us in tests to pass through with courage.
Dynamicity creating spices of life...
helping us to adapt to changes.
Weaving was all set and done
She weaved a book from life to lifetimes
And...
A book forest grew.
